knowGod.title: Know God
knowGod.shortDescription: God created you with gifts and a unique personality.
knowGod.expandedDescription: God created you with gifts, talents, and a unique personality. Discover how to live with purpose, identity, and direction.

findFreedom.title: Find Freedom
findFreedom.shortDescription: Live free from emotional and spiritual chains.
findFreedom.expandedDescription: Learn to let go of the past, heal your wounds, and walk with a firm and secure identity.

discoverPurpose.title: Discover Your Purpose
discoverPurpose.shortDescription: There is a specific purpose for your life.
discoverPurpose.expandedDescription: Identify your gifts, develop your leadership, and walk clearly toward what you were called to do.

makeDifference.title: Make a Difference
makeDifference.shortDescription: Grow so you can impact the world around you.
makeDifference.expandedDescription: Discover how to serve, lead, and make a real difference in your community using your gifts.

services.title: A place to grow, serve, and connect.
services.description: PowerHouse exists to walk with you through every season and help you live a purposeful faith.
services.nextStep: Take the next step and discover how you can be part of PowerHouse.

community.title: Connect with community
community.description: Find a place to share, grow, and build bonds that go beyond Sunday.
community.details: Join groups and gatherings where you can meet people, share your story, and walk alongside others during the week.

purpose.title: Discover your purpose
purpose.description: Recognize your gifts and find practical ways to put them at the service of something greater.
purpose.details: We help you identify your talents and give them direction through guidance, training, and support.

family.title: Grow as a family
family.description: Experiences designed so every generation can find a place to belong.
family.details: There are spaces for children, youth, adults, and families, designed for everyone to grow at their own pace and connect with others.

impact.title: Serve and make an impact
impact.description: Join initiatives that turn faith into concrete action for our city.
impact.details: Join service and volunteer initiatives that respond to real needs and create meaningful change in our city.

common.missionTitle: We turn opportunities into new paths.
common.missionLead: A transformed life can transform others.
common.missionText: You have gifts, talents, and a unique personality created with intention. There is a purpose for your life, and we want to help you discover it.
common.missionOrganization: We are a nonprofit organization connected to education, social inclusion, and skills development. We believe one opportunity can change a story.
common.aboutTitle: People who accompany and guide our community.
common.aboutDescription: We accompany people, families, and leaders with a vision of faith, service, and community.
common.beliefsDescription: The sacred foundation that guides our faith and life in community.
common.ministriesTitle: There is a place for you.
common.ministriesDescription: Discover spaces to connect, grow, and be part of the community.
common.contactDescription: Thank you for taking this time. Answer these questions so we can better accompany you in your first step with our community.
common.footerTitle: A place to live your purpose.
common.footerDescription: A community that believes in people, faith, and the impact we can create together.
common.bankTransfer: You can also donate by bank transfer
common.whatsappMessage: Hello PowerHouse. I would like more information about you, your service areas, and courses. God bless you.
common.impactLead: An opportunity can also open a path to the future.
common.impactTitle: Power Kids: Learning, Growing and Enjoying Together
common.impactDescription: Our goal is for every child to develop values, identity, and a solid foundation from an early age through teaching, games, and activities designed especially for them. We provide safe, loving spaces where they can learn, have fun, and grow.
common.beliefsClosing: Our passion is to see families saved by Jesus.
